context_pdisk-usage: The share of PDisk chunk space used by the residing VDisks. Doesn't include SysLog and CommonLog usage
context_vdisk-slot-usage: Percentage of used VDisk space relative to the first low-space warning. Can exceed 100%.
context_vdisk-raw-usage: Percentage of used VDisk space relative to its fair share on the PDisk. Can exceed 100%.
context_normalized-occupancy: Internal score used for gently handling low-space cases.
context_capacity-alert: The named status used for the graceful low space handling.
context_group-size-in-units: Relative capacity of this group (1 = single, 2 = double, …). Affects VDisk space quota on the PDisk.
context_slot-size-in-units: Relative size of this PDisk in the cluster (1 = single, 2 = double, …). Same units as Group Size In Units.
